name: TOKAI Corp.
summary: TOKAI Corp. provides various healthy life services in Japan. It operates through Health and Life Services, Pharmacy Services, and Environmental Services segments. The company engages in hospital-related business that includes rental of hospital bedding and white coats, linen supply, nursing assistance, and in-hospital logistics management.
